thesaurus.definition: under group or government control

wiktionary.gloss: subsidized for social reasons

blocks.etymology: Probably from tag (“children’s chasing game in which one player (known as ‘it’) attempts to touch another, who then becomes ‘it’; (baseball) instance of touching the baserunner with the ball or the ball in a gloved hand to rule him ‘out’”) + team.

wiktionary.gloss: A group of wrestlers who work together as a team. Only one is in the ring at any given time, and they change places by "tagging" each other with a gesture like a high five.
Two or more people acting alternately to accomplish some task.

An act of two or more people having sex with one person who is the focus of the sexual activity; a gangbang (sense 1); also, the people having sex with the person who is the focus of the sexual activity regarded as a group.

senses.definition: To push prices to force other traders' automatic sell orders.

examples.en: Big funds take out the stops before rallies.
examples.vi: Các quỹ lớn đẩy giá kích hoạt lệnh dừng lỗ trước đợt tăng.

senses.vi: đẩy giá để kích hoạt lệnh dừng lỗ của người khác

wiktionary.gloss: To carry out the supposed practice whereby locals (floor traders trading for their own account) buy or sell to push prices towards where they suspect stop loss orders lie, with a view to profiting from the resulting acceleration of the move when those orders hit the market.

wiktionary.gloss: To release or let go; to permit (someone or something) to roam freely or to act freely.
